sessions.phase_label: Onboarding, task tracking, and initial research deliverables
Research corrections, CRM constraints, and content-operation planning
Commerce catalog processing and Airbnb outreach execution
Revised outreach workflow, AI content assignment, and engagement closure

requirements.title: Platform Access Confirmation
requirements.definition: Confirm access to each assigned business platform without reviewing its workflow unless separately instructed.
requirements.boundary_note: This covers the onboarding access check only; later operational tasks performed inside CJ Dropshipping, HubSpot, Airbnb, Shopify, and social platforms are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: ClickUp Task Status Management
requirements.definition: Maintain accurate completion status in ClickUp by closing completed subtasks while leaving parent Goal tasks open.
requirements.boundary_note: Task-status semantics are independent of where deliverable files are stored and whether deliverable links are included.

requirements.title: Per-Task Google Folder Storage
requirements.definition: Place each completed work product in the Google folder or document linked from its corresponding task.
requirements.boundary_note: This governs the destination of work products; the substantive content of CRM, Pinterest, commerce, and content-bank deliverables remains under separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Deliverable Link Inclusion
requirements.definition: Include the required supporting or result links in completed task deliverables.
requirements.boundary_note: Link completeness can be corrected independently of file placement and ClickUp completion status, so it remains a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Fact-Based Research Without AI
requirements.definition: Produce factual research manually rather than using AI when the client identifies a task as requiring checked facts.
requirements.boundary_note: This constraint applies only to the factual work referenced by the client and does not conflict with later tasks that explicitly require AI-assisted content creation.

requirements.title: Build CRM Structure Deliverable
requirements.definition: Complete and submit the assigned CRM structure artifact in the designated document.
requirements.boundary_note: The available messages establish a distinct CRM structure deliverable but do not expose enough detail to infer its internal fields; HubSpot form configuration is separately testable.

requirements.title: Pinterest Competitor Research Deliverable
requirements.definition: Complete Pinterest Task 1 competitor research, including the requested profiles and supporting links.
requirements.boundary_note: Task 1 has its own correction and completion trajectory and is distinct from Pinterest Task 2.

requirements.title: Pinterest Task 2 Deliverable
requirements.definition: Complete the separately assigned Pinterest Task 2 work product.
requirements.boundary_note: The task is independently assigned and completed, but its substantive acceptance criteria are not visible in the supplied history.

requirements.title: HubSpot Contact Form Configuration
requirements.definition: Configure the HubSpot contact form with the required fields or properties needed by the assigned task.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the initial form-configuration task that became blocked and was later set aside; later entry of fully secured leads into HubSpot is a different operational Requirement.

requirements.title: Outreach Tool Research
requirements.definition: Research tools that could make the ongoing outreach process easier.
requirements.boundary_note: The requested research artifact is independent of executing Airbnb outreach or maintaining lead records.

requirements.title: Google Content Bank
requirements.definition: Set up and populate the Google spreadsheet used as the reusable content bank.
requirements.boundary_note: Building and populating the content-bank artifact is independently verifiable from creating AI posts or publishing posts from the bank.

requirements.title: Daily Content Scheduling and Publishing
requirements.definition: Schedule and publish posts daily from the content bank once access to the required applications is available.
requirements.boundary_note: This covers recurring publication behavior rather than creation of the content-bank artifact or brand-specific AI content.

requirements.title: CJ Product Selection and Import
requirements.definition: Identify promising products, confirm CJ Dropshipping availability, evaluate demand signals, and stage selected products in CJ for publication.
requirements.boundary_note: Product selection criteria and CJ staging form the pre-publication mechanism; Shopify publication, TikTok publication, tracking, and batch quantity can each change or fail independently.

requirements.title: Shopify Product Listing
requirements.definition: Publish selected CJ Dropshipping products to the Thai Market Finds Shopify website and assign or later correct their website categories.
requirements.boundary_note: Shopify listing has a separate execution trajectory from TikTok Shop listing, including successful Shopify completion while the other channel encountered an error.

requirements.title: TikTok Shop Product Listing
requirements.definition: Publish all selected products to TikTok Shop using the platform-generated product type where applicable.
requirements.boundary_note: TikTok Shop publication is independently executable and can fail while Shopify publication succeeds, so the two channels must not be merged.

requirements.title: Product Listing Tracking Spreadsheet
requirements.definition: Record required product details in the designated spreadsheet and track website and TikTok publication side by side.
requirements.boundary_note: Tracking data is an independent artifact from the actual publication of products on Shopify or TikTok Shop.

requirements.title: Daily Product Processing Volume
requirements.definition: Process the required number of products for each daily catalog batch.
requirements.boundary_note: The quantity is an end-to-end acceptance condition independent of platform-specific publication behavior; the instruction to process 15 addresses the current batch and should not automatically erase the stated daily target of 20.

requirements.title: Airbnb Host Selection and Contact
requirements.definition: Select Airbnb properties across the target areas and contact hosts directly as an ongoing outreach activity without spending time screening reviews.
requirements.boundary_note: Property selection and contact execution are separate from the exact outreach-message wording, lead-record filtering, and later booking coordination.

requirements.title: Airbnb Outreach Message
requirements.definition: Use the supplied copy-and-paste outreach message, adapting or resolving its wording when needed for successful delivery through Airbnb.
requirements.boundary_note: The message template has its own failure and possible revision path because Airbnb blocked platform names and contact information; this should not be hidden inside the broader host-selection workflow.

requirements.title: Airbnb Lead Spreadsheet
requirements.definition: Maintain the outreach spreadsheet with only hosts who respond or express interest in moving forward.
requirements.boundary_note: Spreadsheet inclusion is a lead-state rule independent of sending outreach messages and independent of the later HubSpot entry condition.

requirements.title: Airbnb Partnership Scheduling
requirements.definition: Coordinate a visit or content date with interested Airbnb hosts, using the stated October-to-November operating window.
requirements.boundary_note: Scheduling begins only after host interest and can evolve independently of initial outreach or CRM recording.

requirements.title: Secured Lead HubSpot Entry
requirements.definition: Add an Airbnb partnership lead to HubSpot only after the arrangement has been fully secured.
requirements.boundary_note: This later-stage CRM entry rule is distinct from the abandoned HubSpot contact-form configuration task and from preliminary spreadsheet tracking.

requirements.title: Southern Drive AI Content
requirements.definition: Create AI-assisted Southern Drive Mobility social posts using the supplied service descriptions, calls to action, contact details, and diagnostic-service pricing information.
requirements.boundary_note: Southern Drive content has different brand, service, pricing, and CTA requirements from Thai Market Finds TikTok content and therefore remains a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Thai Market Finds TikTok Content Creation
requirements.definition: Create Thai Market Finds TikTok posts by selecting opportunities in Creator Search Insights, developing them through AI Canvas, adapting them to an appropriate post format, and adding brand-specific recommendations and calls to action.
requirements.boundary_note: This covers the reusable Thai Market Finds creation workflow; daily publication from the content bank and Southern Drive content are independently actionable Requirements.

unresolved_candidates.description: The client clearly prohibits AI for fact-based work, but the supplied context does not identify every task to which that constraint applies.
Pinterest Task 2 is independently completed, but its substantive content and acceptance criteria are absent from the supplied history.
The client says 'Yes confirmed,' but the preceding concrete proposal is not included, so the accepted Requirement cannot be identified safely.
A product-listing error is reported, but the empty attachment message prevents confirmation of the exact error and target platform solely from the visible text.
The Southern Drive assignment mentions both about 10 pieces and 20 pieces; Event extraction should preserve this material quantity uncertainty rather than selecting one silently.

The freelancer requests revocation of all granted access after ending the engagement, but no client confirmation is visible; whether to create an access-revocation Requirement requires authority adjudication.
